entries.note: Moves change pane membership only. File/root/session ownership remains on the stable tab record. Restoration validates bounds, integral indices, unique tabs, a single connected acyclic split tree and a leaf active pane before replacing the live layout. Empty leaves remain available for additional views. The 29-node tree permits 15 leaves: each leaf uses two microui root containers and the toolbar uses one, below pristine upstream microui's fixed 32-root limit.
